envelope.description: Retain review endpoints as stateless rewritten errors

body.title: Retain review endpoints as stateless rewritten errors
body.summary: Freeze existing MCP schemas and exact 27-operation inventory. Isolate public schema definitions from execution contracts, replace MCP/step/IPC/legacy review entrypoints with family-specific errors, remove MCP persistent review connections, and preserve ordinary error transport and human decision endpoints. Remove/bypass review-specific host/router ownership allocation before unavailable dispatch; defer deletion of orphan ownership infrastructure to t3.
acceptanceChecks: All 2 MCP tools and 25 IPC review methods remain registered with unchanged callable MCP schemas and accepted phase sets.
Every valid review operation reports the exact family-specific rewritten error without repo resolution, provider/file access, worker/process creation or retained MCP connections.
Human workflow.reviewDecision and generic artifact/team endpoints remain outside automated-review retirement.
Unavailable review dispatch allocates no review owner in step host or router before reaching the error handler.

tests.name: All preserved review operations and accepted MCP phases report exact rewrite errors without allocating review state
Repeated unavailable MCP calls allocate no persistent review connections and preserve transport error envelopes
